map.1 亩≈666.67 m²，深度按 mm 计；利用系数=有效水量/毛用水量。: 1 mu ~ 666.67 m², depth in mm; efficiency = effective water / gross water.
map.毛用水量（m³）= 面积(亩) × 666.67 × 深度(mm) ÷ 1000: Gross water (m³) = area (mu) x 666.67 x depth (mm) / 1000 / efficiency
map.根据灌溉面积、计划灌水深度和灌溉水利用系数，估算毛灌溉用水量与有效灌水量。: Estimate gross and effective irrigation water from irrigated area, planned depth, and water-use efficiency.
map.滴灌、喷灌利用系数一般 0.85-0.95，漫灌可能只有 0.5-0.7: Drip and sprinkler efficiency typically 0.85-0.95; flood irrigation may be only 0.5-0.7
map.按灌水定额估算一次灌水总量：V = 面积 × 灌水定额（m³/亩）。: Estimate one irrigation total from quota: V = area x quota (m³/mu).
map.ETc 与有效降雨，反推净灌溉定额。: ETc and effective rainfall, back-calculate net irrigation quota.
map.用于井灌区取水量核算与配水计划。: Used for well-irrigation withdrawal accounting and water distribution planning.
map.玉米拔节期一次灌水: One irrigation for corn jointing stage
map.面积 50 亩，灌水定额 40 m³/亩，则本次灌水总量 V = 50 × 40: Area 50 mu, quota 40 m³/mu, total V = 50 x 40 = 2000 m³. If source pump flow is 50 m³/h, continuous supply for 40 hours is needed.
map.灌水定额和灌溉定额有什么区别？: What is the difference between irrigation quota and total irrigation quota?
map.灌水定额是『一次』灌水的量（m³/亩），灌溉定额是『全生育期』各次灌水定额之和。: Irrigation quota is one irrigation's volume (m³/mu); total irrigation quota is the sum of all quotas over the whole growth period. Both are needed when designing canals and pumps.
map.怎么考虑降雨省下的水？: How to account for water saved by rainfall?
map.净灌溉量 = 作物需水 ETc − 有效降雨 Pe。汛期降雨集中时，应在每次灌前: Net irrigation = crop demand ETc - effective rainfall Pe. During concentrated rainy season, deduct recent rainfall before each irrigation to avoid waterlogging from over-irrigation.
map.根据作物灌溉制度，快速估算一次灌溉所需水量，便于水源调度和用水成本核算。: Quickly estimate one irrigation's required water from the crop irrigation schedule, easing water-source dispatch and cost accounting.
map.支持不同灌溉方式利用系数: Supports efficiency for different irrigation methods
